program_title: Certificate in Ethiopian Canon Studies — development track
numbering_note: SEM delivery codes supplement the existing ECS-301 through ECS-306 curriculum; they do not supersede or rename those program requirements.
hours_note: Editorial workload estimates for a survey using selected passages, not credit awards, verified attendance, full-text completion claims, or validated workload measurements.
award_status: No certificate or degree issued by this build. Assessed awards require academic adoption, authorized issuer, instructor review, and student records.
unresolved_existing_requirement: ECS-302 History of Ethiopian Christianity requires a distinct history learning sequence and assessment; source playlists are candidates, not a completed course.

courses.title: Start Here: Orientation
courses.summary: Prepare a study plan, learn the canon numbering basis, and create a traceable reading record.

courses.title: Torah and Israel’s Beginnings
courses.summary: Study creation, covenant, liberation, law, land, leadership, and belonging across the first eight registry entries.

courses.title: Israel’s History and Restoration
courses.summary: Examine monarchy, exile, return, communal identity, and the transmission of historical traditions.

courses.title: Enoch, Jubilees, and Meqabyan
courses.summary: Read selected Ethiopic texts with attention to textual identity, covenant, judgment, and historical context.

courses.title: Wisdom, Prayer, and Formation
courses.summary: Compare wisdom instruction, prayer, suffering, love, and moral formation through close reading.

courses.title: Major Prophets
courses.summary: Interpret judgment, restoration, hope, and prophetic literature while documenting grouped-text boundaries.

courses.title: The Twelve Prophets
courses.summary: Analyze prophetic voices, literary forms, justice, worship, exile, and restoration.

courses.title: Gospels and Acts
courses.summary: Compare Gospel narratives and study the formation and mission of early Christian communities.

courses.title: Pauline Letters and Hebrews
courses.summary: Analyze letter argument, community ethics, theology, and Hebrews without assuming Pauline authorship of Hebrews.

courses.title: General Epistles and Revelation
courses.summary: Study faith, practice, witness, conflict, and apocalyptic interpretation with attention to genre.

courses.title: Ethiopian Church Order
courses.summary: Distinguish the specified Sinodos, Covenant, Clement, and Didascalia texts and examine church life and teaching.

courses.title: Canon Studies Capstone
courses.summary: Defend an evidence portfolio, compare canonical traditions, and present a reviewed teaching project.
